meta.name: Chiraiya
meta.description:
Kamlesh's world as a devoted wife and daughter-in-law shatters when her new sister-in-law confides a disturbing secret about her wedding night, forcing Kamlesh to confront uncomfortable truths within her own family.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Griha Pravesh
videos.overview: Kamlesh loves Arun like a son and reluctantly accepts his marriage to Pooja. On their wedding night, Arun disregards Pooja's illness while Kamlesh, unaware, celebrates outside.

videos.title: Pag Phera
videos.overview: Pooja shares her experience with her mother, but she brushes off her worries and urges her to return. On her way back, Pooja makes the decision to escape.

videos.title: Honeymoon
videos.overview: Kamlesh disbelieves the concept of marital rape and ignores Pooja's pleas. However, Kamlesh educates herself on the issue, and something shifts within her.

videos.title: Muh Dikhai
videos.overview: Pooja and Kamlesh wait for the right moment to approach Bhramar, believing he will support them. Meanwhile, Kamlesh admits that she is partly responsible for Arun's behaviour.

videos.title: Vidaai
videos.overview: Kamlesh is let down after Bhramar refuses to act against Arun. With Vinay's support, she takes Pooja to her grandfather, only to learn there's no legal recourse for marital rape.

videos.title: Kathaa
videos.overview: Bhramar tries manipulating the situation, causing their defiance to weaken. However, drawing inspiration from an unexpected source, they prepare to fight the system publicly.
